evidence_items.locator: Section 3.2, Probable Cause, page 58; also Executive Summary
evidence_items.explanation: The investigation attributes the fatal Mountain View crash partly to Autopilot steering outside the travel lane because of vision-processing limitations, alongside driver distraction and ineffective engagement monitoring. Its description of lane keeping and cruise control supports classifying this as limited-purpose AI, not AGI.
